versions.changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-media-gen.

- Generate both images (via Gemini 3 Pro Image) and videos (via Qwen Wan 2.6) with a single API key.
- Added image generation with Gemini 3 Pro endpoint and video generation via Qwen Wan 2.6 (asynchronous tasks).
- Included curl examples and Python client scripts for quick start.
- Provided full API references and usage instructions.
- Requires only python3, curl, and an AISA_API_KEY environment variable.
